title: Makeup Mirror 8-Inch Freestanding Floor Stand Solid Brass 2X/1X Double-Sided | Allied Brass
description:
Get a clear, close-up view for makeup or shaving without sacrificing a full-face check. This freestanding, floor-standing make-up mirror features double-sided mirror glass with 2X magnification on one side and 1X on the other for everyday grooming at a comfortable angle—an easy fit for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- See fine details for precise grooming: 2X magnification on one side for close-up applications
- Check your overall look instantly: 1X mirror on the opposite side for an all-around view
- Place it anywhere in the bathroom: freestanding floor stand design requires no wall mounting
- Feel steady during use: heavy solid brass base is designed to help prevent tipping
- Protect countertops and floors: felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Freestanding floor standing make-up mirror
- Mirror: 8-Inch diameter, double faced mirror glass
- Magnification: 2X on one side, 1X on the other
- Material: Brass construction
- Overall dimensions (L x W): 10.5 in x 10.5 in
- Weight: 13.6 lb
- Included: Make-up mirror
- Assembly: Required
- Finish options: Available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including 25 options and statement colors to coordinate with heritage bathroom fixtures.
